<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Skilled Herbalist](/Feats.aspx?ID=5325) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 31

</column>

---

You've been taught how to craft healing remedies with a variety of herbs and plants. You gain the [Alchemical Crafting](/Feats.aspx?ID=5117) feat, except you must select the following items to add to your formula book: [lesser antidote](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2879), [lesser antiplague](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2880), and [minor elixir of life](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2887), as well as a fourth 1st-level common alchemical formula of your choice. You can use [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) an [alchemical](/Traits.aspx?ID=528) item that has the [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623) trait, rather than [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37).

<title level="2">Skilled Herbalist leads to...</title>
[Herbal Forager](/Feats.aspx?ID=5331)
